definitions.gloss: bottom of a valley; valley floor
definitions.explanation: The lowest point of a valley. Also used figuratively to mean the lowest point of a situation, such as an economic depression.

examples.japanese: {谷底|たにそこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れている→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
examples.english: A river flows at the bottom of the valley.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{谷底|たにそこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転落|てんらく}→転落：19790_tenraku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A car fell from the cliff to the bottom of the valley.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{谷底|たにそこ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧し⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{好感|こうかん}→好感：16431_koukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}した→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: The market reacted favorably to reports that the economy had begun to recover from its lowest point.

notes:
{谷底|たにそこ} is a compound of ⟦{谷|たに}→谷：02223_tani⟧ (valley) and ⟦{底|そこ}→底：12560_soko⟧ (bottom). It refers to the lowest point of a valley.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {谷底|たにそこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ (fall to the bottom of a valley)
- {谷底|たにそこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転落|てんらく}→転落：19790_tenraku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (plunge into the valley)
- ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{谷底|たにそこ} (the trough of the economy)

The word is also used figuratively to describe the lowest point of an economic cycle or personal hardship. In economic contexts, {谷底|たにそこ} is the opposite of ⟦{山頂|さんちょう}→山頂：09942_sanchou⟧ or ⟦ピーク→ピーク：11174_piiku⟧ (peak).
